$comment: SDL-658. Each section: promises it carries and its revisions. The last revision is current; its sha256 must equal the file. A text changes ONLY on a direct owner request: a new revision with a new version, effective_date and owner_request. apps/admin/scripts/validate-policy.mjs fails the build otherwise. A section may carry translations: { <locale>: { file, of_version, sha256 } } — the same text in another language (SDL-784). A translation is NOT a revision: it does not move version, effective_date or the edition; of_version names the Russian revision it renders and must equal the current one, and its sha256 must equal the file. Locales without a translation (kk) read the Russian text.

promise_keys.workspace_limits: Counting limits of a workspace are enforced: write stops at the limit, read/delete/published site keep working (EP-127 items 2, 10)
promise_keys.workspace_trash: Workspace delete goes to the trash for trash_days, site goes dark at once, restore, purge within a day, Delete forever (EP-127 items 4, 10)
promise_keys.item_delete_confirm: Page, record and file are deleted at once after a confirmation; a file in use shows where (SDL-650)
promise_keys.member_revocation: A removed member loses access on the next request (gw-service internal/middleware/revocation.go, SDL-615)
promise_keys.workspace_invites: Members can be invited into a workspace (collections invites, SDL-615 S9)
promise_keys.data_plane_no_cookies: The public data plane never uses cookies; no visitor analytics (gw-service internal/middleware/data_cors.go)
promise_keys.names_registry: Workspace name rules and the names registry (EP-127 items 8, 9; EP-113)
promise_keys.logs_retention_30d: Container log lines older than 30 days are removed: the log-retention DaemonSet (dev-infra apps/log-retention, DRY_RUN=0) deletes and trims /var/log/pods on every node once a day, so a line lives at most 30 days plus up to one day until the next pass (about 31 days); there is no other log store (SDL-739). Not covered: node system journals, Sentry events
promise_keys.account_deletion: Self-deletion of the account erases it: sign-in closes at once, every workspace of the person goes to the trash with an expired term and is ERASED by the next purge (collections PURGE_MODE=enforce), memberships and sent invites are removed, all sessions revoked (SDL-740..743)
promise_keys.session_logout: Sign-out always expires the session cookies in this browser (SDL-613 S6a); revoking the refresh-token family in auth-service (S5) is an attempt, not a guarantee: if auth-service is unreachable the family is not revoked and lives until its own expiry (JWT_REFRESH_TTL). An access token already issued lives until its exp (JWT_ACCESS_TTL)
promise_keys.landing_no_analytics: The landing markerloop.com ships no analytics: zero script tags and no cookies; analytics is a build-time opt-in through PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_* and those CI variables are not set (SDL-745)
promise_keys.legal_review: The text was reviewed by a lawyer; turned on only by the owner
